verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in natural-language interface, assistant, or conversational command mode in 1Password itself. The documented surfaces are a structured CLI (e.g. `op item list --vault Private`), SDKs, REST APIs, and MCP servers. The Environments MCP Server lets external agents such as Claude Code manage Environments, but that is an MCP-server capability used through a third-party agent host, so it is adjacent and belongs to a different story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
